courses.title: 舊金山金門大橋
courses.summary: 從海峽選址、懸索受力到橋面更換與耐震改造，用 24 道概念模型練習理解一座仍在使用的大跨橋梁。
courses.summaryEn: Use 24 conceptual exercises to connect strait constraints and suspension forces with deck replacement and seismic rehabilitation of a working long-span bridge.
courses.scope: 以公開一次資料為背景的原創工程判讀課程；每步在紙上或數位示意模型中完成。自設數值、構形與工序不得當成原工程的設計、施工、設備操作或驗收程序。
courses.scopeEn: Original engineering interpretation exercises grounded in public primary sources. Complete each step on paper or in a schematic digital model. Invented values, geometry and sequences are not the original project’s design, construction, operating or acceptance procedures.

stages.title: 場址、邊界與受力
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「場址、邊界與受力」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on site, boundaries and force paths, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 把海峽需求放進場址圖
steps.objective: 辨認航道、岸線與跨越位置的共同限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify joint constraints from navigation, shorelines and crossing location.
steps.instruction: 1. 自繪兩岸與航道；2. 分別標示塔位及錨碇區；3. 列出水深、地盤與航道資料缺口。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch shores and navigation corridor; 2. mark tower and anchorage zones separately; 3. list missing depth, ground and navigation evidence.
steps.observation: 跨距相近的方案仍可能有不同的基礎及航運限制。
steps.observationEn: Similar spans may still imply different foundation and navigation constraints.
steps.failure: 僅以最短跨距判定塔位可行。
steps.failureEn: Choose tower locations from the shortest span alone.
steps.check: 提交有圖例的場址圖及三個待查資料欄。
steps.checkEn: Submit a keyed site map and three evidence gaps.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 選址同時改變側跨比例、施工可達性及支承條件，不能只比跨距。
knowledge.textEn: Siting changes side-span proportions, access and support conditions, so span alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 地圖座標只定位工程背景；地質與海事邊界需要專門調查。
knowledge.textEn: A map pin locates project context; ground and marine boundaries require dedicated investigation.

quiz.question: 審查「把海峽需求放進場址圖」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Map the strait requirements”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 跨距相近的方案仍可能有不同的基礎及航運限制。
僅以最短跨距判定塔位可行。
塔位只影響外觀，不會改變側跨與反力。
optionsEn: Similar spans may still imply different foundation and navigation constraints.
Choose tower locations from the shortest span alone.
Tower locations affect appearance only, not side spans or reactions.
quiz.explanation: 選址同時改變側跨比例、施工可達性及支承條件，不能只比跨距。 地圖座標只定位工程背景；地質與海事邊界需要專門調查。
quiz.explanationEn: Siting changes side-span proportions, access and support conditions, so span alone is insufficient. A map pin locates project context; ground and marine boundaries require dedicated investigation.

steps.title: 區分全橋與主跨尺寸
steps.objective: 避免把不同統計邊界混成同一個橋長。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid conflating different definitions of bridge length.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫全橋、懸吊區、主跨三條尺寸線；2. 依官方表標記各自端點；3. 記錄單位與是否包含引橋。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw overall, suspended and main-span dimension lines; 2. mark their endpoints from the official table; 3. record units and whether approaches are included.
steps.observation: 尺寸比較只有在端點與單位一致時才成立。
steps.observationEn: Dimensions are comparable only when endpoints and units agree.
steps.failure: 把包含引橋的長度當成兩塔之間的距離。
steps.failureEn: Treat a length including approaches as the distance between towers.
steps.check: 繳交三條尺寸線和各自的邊界定義。
steps.checkEn: Provide three dimension lines with their boundary definitions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 主跨是兩座主塔間的跨度；全橋長度可包含側跨及引橋。
knowledge.textEn: The main span lies between the main towers; overall length can include side spans and approaches.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 統計資料的精確位數不能修正錯誤的量測邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Numerical precision cannot correct an incorrectly defined measurement boundary.

quiz.question: 審查「區分全橋與主跨尺寸」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate overall and main-span dimensions”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 把包含引橋的長度當成兩塔之間的距離。
尺寸比較只有在端點與單位一致時才成立。
單位一致時便可以忽略兩個尺寸的起訖位置。
optionsEn: Treat a length including approaches as the distance between towers.
Dimensions are comparable only when endpoints and units agree.
Matching units make dimension endpoints irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 主跨是兩座主塔間的跨度；全橋長度可包含側跨及引橋。 統計資料的精確位數不能修正錯誤的量測邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: The main span lies between the main towers; overall length can include side spans and approaches. Numerical precision cannot correct an incorrectly defined measurement boundary.

steps.title: 追蹤橋面重力至地盤
steps.titleEn: Trace deck gravity to the ground
steps.objective: 區分吊索、主纜、塔與錨碇的作用。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish the roles of hangers, main cables, towers and anchorages.
steps.instruction: 1. 在橋面放一個假想載荷；2. 畫到吊索及主纜的傳力箭頭；3. 分別追到塔基與端部錨碇反力。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Place a hypothetical deck load; 2. trace force arrows through hangers and main cables; 3. close the paths through tower foundations and end anchorages.
steps.observation: 完整力路徑必須包含主纜端部的水平反力。
steps.observationEn: A complete force path includes horizontal reactions at the main-cable ends.
steps.failure: 只畫塔的壓力就認為所有纜索拉力已平衡。
steps.failureEn: Assume tower compression alone balances every cable force.
steps.check: 提交一張閉合到地盤的受力圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a force diagram closed through the ground.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 柔性纜索主要承受拉力，塔與錨碇分擔不同方向的支承反力。
knowledge.textEn: Flexible cables act mainly in tension; towers and anchorages provide different support reactions.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 受力箭頭與位移箭頭應分色，否則容易把作用與反應混淆。
knowledge.textEn: Use separate symbols for forces and movements to avoid confusing actions with responses.

quiz.question: 審查「追蹤橋面重力至地盤」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Trace deck gravity to the ground”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只畫塔的壓力就認為所有纜索拉力已平衡。
端部錨碇只供裝飾，主纜不會把力傳到它。
完整力路徑必須包含主纜端部的水平反力。
optionsEn: Assume tower compression alone balances every cable force.
End anchorages are decorative and receive no cable force.
A complete force path includes horizontal reactions at the main-cable ends.
quiz.explanation: 柔性纜索主要承受拉力，塔與錨碇分擔不同方向的支承反力。 受力箭頭與位移箭頭應分色，否則容易把作用與反應混淆。
quiz.explanationEn: Flexible cables act mainly in tension; towers and anchorages provide different support reactions. Use separate symbols for forces and movements to avoid confusing actions with responses.

steps.title: 比較橋型與反力邊界
steps.objective: 看出懸索、斜張與拱橋的力學差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize mechanical differences between suspension, cable-stayed and arch bridges.
steps.instruction: 1. 自繪三種橋型；2. 標出主要拉力或壓力構件；3. 保持相同跨越需求，列出各型式需要的支承證據。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch three bridge forms; 2. label principal tension or compression members; 3. keep the crossing requirement fixed and list support evidence for each.
steps.observation: 外形相似的跨越構造不一定具有相同反力方向。
steps.observationEn: Similar crossing silhouettes need not produce the same reaction directions.
steps.failure: 把斜張索當成懸索橋主纜下的垂直吊索。
steps.failureEn: Treat cable stays as vertical hangers below a suspension main cable.
steps.check: 提交橋型、力型與地盤需求的三欄比較表。
steps.checkEn: Submit a table of bridge form, force type and ground requirements.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 懸索經主纜與吊索承托橋面；斜張索則直接連接橋塔與橋面。
knowledge.textEn: Suspension decks hang from main cables through hangers; stays directly connect a tower and deck.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 倒置纜索曲線可幫助理解拱的壓力，但不能取代拱橋穩定分析。
knowledge.textEn: An inverted cable curve illustrates arch compression but does not replace arch stability analysis.

quiz.question: 審查「比較橋型與反力邊界」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare bridge forms and reactions”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 外形相似的跨越構造不一定具有相同反力方向。
把斜張索當成懸索橋主纜下的垂直吊索。
拱橋與懸索橋的主要承重構件都只承受拉力。
optionsEn: Similar crossing silhouettes need not produce the same reaction directions.
Treat cable stays as vertical hangers below a suspension main cable.
The principal members of arches and suspension bridges both carry tension only.
quiz.explanation: 懸索經主纜與吊索承托橋面；斜張索則直接連接橋塔與橋面。 倒置纜索曲線可幫助理解拱的壓力，但不能取代拱橋穩定分析。
quiz.explanationEn: Suspension decks hang from main cables through hangers; stays directly connect a tower and deck. An inverted cable curve illustrates arch compression but does not replace arch stability analysis.

steps.title: 建立溫度與車流情境
steps.objective: 把不同荷載組合當成不同模型狀態。
steps.objectiveEn: Treat different load combinations as distinct model states.
steps.instruction: 1. 定義無量綱的冷、暖兩情境；2. 分配主跨或側跨假想車流；3. 先預測再比較橋面位移方向。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Define dimensionless cool and warm cases; 2. distribute hypothetical traffic on main or side spans; 3. predict then compare deck-movement directions.
steps.observation: 橋面位移同時受纜長變化與載荷分布影響。
steps.observationEn: Deck movement depends on cable-length changes and load distribution together.
steps.failure: 只看車輛總數就斷言主跨一定向下同樣多。
steps.failureEn: Use vehicle count alone to assert identical downward main-span movement.
steps.check: 繳交至少四個有邊界條件的情境卡。
steps.checkEn: Provide at least four scenario cards with boundary conditions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 加熱造成的纜索伸長會改變懸吊幾何；活載位置也改變力的平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal cable expansion changes suspension geometry, while live-load position changes equilibrium.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 簡化模型的位移方向可作概念比較，不能作真橋變形限值。
knowledge.textEn: A simplified model can compare movement directions, not set real-bridge deformation limits.

quiz.question: 審查「建立溫度與車流情境」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Define temperature and traffic cases”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只看車輛總數就斷言主跨一定向下同樣多。
橋面位移同時受纜長變化與載荷分布影響。
主纜溫度改變不可能影響橋面位置。
optionsEn: Use vehicle count alone to assert identical downward main-span movement.
Deck movement depends on cable-length changes and load distribution together.
Cable-temperature changes cannot affect deck position.
quiz.explanation: 加熱造成的纜索伸長會改變懸吊幾何；活載位置也改變力的平衡。 簡化模型的位移方向可作概念比較，不能作真橋變形限值。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal cable expansion changes suspension geometry, while live-load position changes equilibrium. A simplified model can compare movement directions, not set real-bridge deformation limits.

steps.title: 做場址階段設計審查
steps.objective: 整合第一階段的尺寸、反力與不確定性。
steps.objectiveEn: Integrate dimensions, reactions and uncertainties from the first stage.
steps.instruction: 1. 將場址圖與受力圖並排；2. 逐一核對尺寸端點和反力落點；3. 指定一個必須補資料才能決定的選項。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Compare site and force diagrams; 2. audit dimension endpoints and reaction locations; 3. identify one choice that requires further evidence.
steps.observation: 未知地盤條件應保留為待查項，而非被漂亮圖面掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Unknown ground conditions should remain unresolved rather than disappear behind a polished drawing.
steps.failure: 把所有未確認欄位填成與另一座橋相同。
steps.failureEn: Fill every unverified field with values borrowed from another bridge.
steps.check: 輸出含假設、證據、待查項的三欄審查單。
steps.checkEn: Produce a review sheet separating assumptions, evidence and open items.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 設計審查要檢查介面是否一致，不只檢查單一構件有無畫出。
knowledge.textEn: Design review checks interface consistency, not merely whether every component is drawn.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 可追溯的未知項比沒有來源的確定數字更有助於後續決策。
knowledge.textEn: Traceable unknowns support later decisions better than unsupported precise numbers.

quiz.question: 審查「做場址階段設計審查」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review the site-stage model”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 把所有未確認欄位填成與另一座橋相同。
圖畫越精細，未知地盤條件就越少。
未知地盤條件應保留為待查項，而非被漂亮圖面掩蓋。
optionsEn: Fill every unverified field with values borrowed from another bridge.
More detailed drawing automatically reduces unknown ground conditions.
Unknown ground conditions should remain unresolved rather than disappear behind a polished drawing.
quiz.explanation: 設計審查要檢查介面是否一致，不只檢查單一構件有無畫出。 可追溯的未知項比沒有來源的確定數字更有助於後續決策。
quiz.explanationEn: Design review checks interface consistency, not merely whether every component is drawn. Traceable unknowns support later decisions better than unsupported precise numbers.

stages.title: 基礎、橋塔與主纜
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「基礎、橋塔與主纜」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on foundations, towers and main cables, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 分開海床與塔基變形
steps.objective: 辨認基礎平移、轉動和橋塔彎曲。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish foundation translation, rotation and tower bending.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫海床、基礎與橋塔三層；2. 分別施加假想平移與轉角；3. 比較相同塔頂位移可能對應的不同原因。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw seabed, foundation and tower layers; 2. apply hypothetical translations and rotations separately; 3. compare different causes of the same tower-top displacement.
steps.observation: 單一塔頂位移不能唯一識別基礎或塔身的變化。
steps.observationEn: One tower-top reading cannot uniquely identify foundation or tower changes.
steps.failure: 塔頂偏移便直接證明海床承載失效。
steps.failureEn: A shifted tower top directly proves seabed bearing failure.
steps.check: 提交兩種具有相同塔頂位移的概念反例。
steps.checkEn: Submit two conceptual cases with the same tower-top displacement.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 剛體轉動與構件彎曲在局部量測上可能相似，需多點觀測分辨。
knowledge.textEn: Rigid rotation and member bending may appear similar locally; multiple observations help distinguish them.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 把測点放在不同高度及基礎附近，可增加辨識不同變形模式的資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Observations at different heights and near foundations improve discrimination between movement modes.

quiz.question: 審查「分開海床與塔基變形」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate seabed and foundation movements”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 單一塔頂位移不能唯一識別基礎或塔身的變化。
塔頂偏移便直接證明海床承載失效。
剛體轉動與塔身彎曲在任何測點都能用單一讀數區分。
optionsEn: One tower-top reading cannot uniquely identify foundation or tower changes.
A shifted tower top directly proves seabed bearing failure.
One reading anywhere always separates rigid rotation from tower bending.
quiz.explanation: 剛體轉動與構件彎曲在局部量測上可能相似，需多點觀測分辨。 把測点放在不同高度及基礎附近，可增加辨識不同變形模式的資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Rigid rotation and member bending may appear similar locally; multiple observations help distinguish them. Observations at different heights and near foundations improve discrimination between movement modes.

steps.title: 拆解塔座的介面資料
steps.objective: 連接地質、混凝土與鋼構三種證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect ground, concrete and steel-interface evidence.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫地盤至塔腳的剖面；2. 在每個交界列出幾何與材料紀錄；3. 將缺失資料標成不能放行的模型介面。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a section from ground to tower foot; 2. list geometry and material records at each interface; 3. flag missing records as unresolved model interfaces.
steps.observation: 上下構件各自合格仍不保證接觸介面吻合。
steps.observationEn: Individually acceptable components do not guarantee a compatible interface.
steps.failure: 上下材料強度足夠便可忽略幾何及接觸條件。
steps.failureEn: Adequate material strengths make geometry and contact conditions irrelevant.
steps.check: 繳交三層介面表，至少列出一項幾何衝突。
steps.checkEn: Provide a three-layer interface table with at least one geometric conflict.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 介面會傳遞力、約束位移並影響施工定位，因此必須獨立檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Interfaces transmit forces, constrain movement and affect positioning, so they require explicit review.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 示意圖中的完美貼合是假設，不是現場接觸品質的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Perfect contact in a schematic is an assumption, not evidence of field contact quality.

quiz.question: 審查「拆解塔座的介面資料」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate tower-base interface records”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 上下材料強度足夠便可忽略幾何及接觸條件。
上下構件各自合格仍不保證接觸介面吻合。
材料來源相同就表示上下構件的幾何一定吻合。
optionsEn: Adequate material strengths make geometry and contact conditions irrelevant.
Individually acceptable components do not guarantee a compatible interface.
A shared material supplier guarantees matching component geometry.
quiz.explanation: 介面會傳遞力、約束位移並影響施工定位，因此必須獨立檢查。 示意圖中的完美貼合是假設，不是現場接觸品質的證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Interfaces transmit forces, constrain movement and affect positioning, so they require explicit review. Perfect contact in a schematic is an assumption, not evidence of field contact quality.

steps.title: 辨認橋塔節間與側向支撐
steps.titleEn: Identify tower panels and lateral bracing
steps.objective: 理解細長塔腿如何形成整體側向系統。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how slender tower legs form a lateral system.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫兩條塔腿及連接節間；2. 用不同顏色標出縱向與橫向變形；3. 比較移除一組概念支撐前後的變形趨勢。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw two tower legs and connecting panels; 2. distinguish longitudinal and transverse deformation; 3. compare trends before and after removing a conceptual brace.
steps.observation: 同樣塔高的模型可因支撐配置不同而有不同側向剛度。
steps.observationEn: Equal-height models can have different lateral stiffness because of bracing layout.
steps.failure: 塔高相同就保證風中位移相同。
steps.failureEn: Identical tower height guarantees identical wind displacement.
steps.check: 提交兩種配置的變形草圖及固定邊界。
steps.checkEn: Submit deformation sketches and support assumptions for two layouts.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 細長結構的穩定性取決於約束與構件共同作用，不能只比較截面面積。
knowledge.textEn: Slender-structure stability depends on restraints and member interaction, not cross-sectional area alone.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 移除支撐的數位試驗只用於概念辨識，不對應實橋可容許損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Digital brace-removal exercises explain mechanisms, not permissible damage to the actual bridge.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認橋塔節間與側向支撐」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Identify tower panels and lateral bracing”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 塔高相同就保證風中位移相同。
塔腿的連接配置不會改變整體變形。
同樣塔高的模型可因支撐配置不同而有不同側向剛度。
optionsEn: Identical tower height guarantees identical wind displacement.
Connections between tower legs cannot affect overall deformation.
Equal-height models can have different lateral stiffness because of bracing layout.
quiz.explanation: 細長結構的穩定性取決於約束與構件共同作用，不能只比較截面面積。 移除支撐的數位試驗只用於概念辨識，不對應實橋可容許損傷。
quiz.explanationEn: Slender-structure stability depends on restraints and member interaction, not cross-sectional area alone. Digital brace-removal exercises explain mechanisms, not permissible damage to the actual bridge.

steps.title: 把單絲、索股與主纜分層
steps.titleEn: Separate wire, strand and main cable
steps.objective: 辨認多尺度的纜索品質紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize cable-quality records at multiple scales.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫單絲、索股、主纜三級樹；2. 把材料試驗、集束幾何與外包保護分配到各級；3. 保留批次追溯連結。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a wire–strand–cable tree; 2. assign material tests, bundle geometry and wrapping to the appropriate levels; 3. retain batch-traceability links.
steps.observation: 單絲試驗只描述局部材料，不直接證明整條主纜狀態。
steps.observationEn: A wire test characterizes local material, not the condition of an entire main cable.
steps.failure: 抽到一根合格單絲即可認定所有索股與接合均正常。
steps.failureEn: One acceptable wire establishes that all strands and connections are sound.
steps.check: 繳交三級追溯樹及每級一種證據。
steps.checkEn: Provide a three-level traceability tree with one evidence type per level.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 主纜由多根鋼絲組成，局部材料、幾何分布與防護狀態影響不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Main cables comprise many wires; local material, geometric distribution and protection address different questions.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 抽樣結果必須連同抽樣位置及代表範圍解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling results must be interpreted with their locations and representativeness.

quiz.question: 審查「把單絲、索股與主纜分層」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate wire, strand and main cable”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 單絲試驗只描述局部材料，不直接證明整條主纜狀態。
抽到一根合格單絲即可認定所有索股與接合均正常。
主纜外包保護的檢查可以直接取代鋼絲材料追溯。
optionsEn: A wire test characterizes local material, not the condition of an entire main cable.
One acceptable wire establishes that all strands and connections are sound.
Cable-wrap inspection directly replaces wire-material traceability.
quiz.explanation: 主纜由多根鋼絲組成，局部材料、幾何分布與防護狀態影響不同問題。 抽樣結果必須連同抽樣位置及代表範圍解讀。
quiz.explanationEn: Main cables comprise many wires; local material, geometric distribution and protection address different questions. Sampling results must be interpreted with their locations and representativeness.

steps.title: 讀懂索鞍與主纜轉向
steps.objective: 把主纜的拉力方向與橋塔反力連起來。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect main-cable tension directions with tower reactions.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫主纜通過塔頂的兩側切線；2. 合成一組自設向量；3. 在索鞍與塔上標記相反作用力。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw cable tangents on both sides of a tower; 2. combine a hypothetical vector pair; 3. mark opposite forces on saddle and tower.
steps.observation: 塔頂反力來自兩側纜索拉力的向量合成。
steps.observationEn: Tower-top reaction follows the vector combination of cable tensions on both sides.
steps.failure: 兩側纜索張力相等就表示塔頂沒有任何受力。
steps.failureEn: Equal tensions on both sides imply zero force on the tower top.
steps.check: 輸出有方向、比例假設與反力的向量圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a vector diagram with directions, scale assumptions and reaction.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 相同大小的斜向力仍可能形成明顯合力，方向比數字相等更重要。
knowledge.textEn: Equal-magnitude inclined forces can produce a substantial resultant; equal numbers do not erase direction.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 索鞍接觸與主纜轉折是局部介面問題，整橋模型通常需另外簡化。
knowledge.textEn: Saddle contact and cable redirection are local interface problems simplified separately in whole-bridge models.

quiz.question: 審查「讀懂索鞍與主纜轉向」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Interpret cable saddles and redirection”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 兩側纜索張力相等就表示塔頂沒有任何受力。
塔頂反力來自兩側纜索拉力的向量合成。
兩個拉力的大小可以直接相減而不考慮方向。
optionsEn: Equal tensions on both sides imply zero force on the tower top.
Tower-top reaction follows the vector combination of cable tensions on both sides.
Two tension magnitudes can be subtracted without considering direction.
quiz.explanation: 相同大小的斜向力仍可能形成明顯合力，方向比數字相等更重要。 索鞍接觸與主纜轉折是局部介面問題，整橋模型通常需另外簡化。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal-magnitude inclined forces can produce a substantial resultant; equal numbers do not erase direction. Saddle contact and cable redirection are local interface problems simplified separately in whole-bridge models.

steps.title: 標示索夾、吊索與防護分工
steps.titleEn: Distinguish cable bands, hangers and protection
steps.objective: 理解傳力連接與腐蝕防護不是同一種功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that load transfer and corrosion protection are different functions.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫主纜、索夾與垂直吊索；2. 標示傳力及排水路徑；3. 將機械連接紀錄與塗覆檢查分成兩份清單。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch main cable, band and vertical hanger; 2. mark force and drainage paths; 3. separate mechanical-connection and coating-inspection records.
steps.observation: 外表塗層完整不能單獨證明連接的機械狀態。
steps.observationEn: An intact surface coating alone does not establish mechanical connection condition.
steps.failure: 外觀沒有鏽色就可省略索夾及吊索端部檢查。
steps.failureEn: No visible rust makes cable-band and hanger-end checks unnecessary.
steps.check: 繳交分開力路徑與水路徑的節點圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a node sketch separating force and water paths.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 局部積水及隙縫環境可能與可見大面積塗層具有不同的腐蝕條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trapped water and crevices can create corrosion conditions different from broad exposed coating surfaces.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 維護紀錄必須指出檢查範圍，不能把外觀檢查擴大為內部健康保證。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance records must state inspection scope rather than turn surface observations into internal-health guarantees.

quiz.question: 審查「標示索夾、吊索與防護分工」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Distinguish cable bands, hangers and protection”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 外觀沒有鏽色就可省略索夾及吊索端部檢查。
排水路徑和傳力路徑完全相同，所以不需分開標記。
外表塗層完整不能單獨證明連接的機械狀態。
optionsEn: No visible rust makes cable-band and hanger-end checks unnecessary.
Drainage and force paths are identical and need no separate labels.
An intact surface coating alone does not establish mechanical connection condition.
quiz.explanation: 局部積水及隙縫環境可能與可見大面積塗層具有不同的腐蝕條件。 維護紀錄必須指出檢查範圍，不能把外觀檢查擴大為內部健康保證。
quiz.explanationEn: Trapped water and crevices can create corrosion conditions different from broad exposed coating surfaces. Maintenance records must state inspection scope rather than turn surface observations into internal-health guarantees.

stages.title: 橋面架設與變形
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「橋面架設與變形」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on deck erection and deformation, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 比較架設前後的受力狀態
steps.objective: 識別未閉合系統中的臨時邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify temporary boundaries in an incomplete system.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫未掛橋面、部分掛設、完成三狀態；2. 在每張圖列出仍缺少的構件；3. 逐一追查剩餘支承與反力。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw bare-cable, partly decked and completed states; 2. list absent components in each; 3. trace the remaining supports and reactions.
steps.observation: 完工橋的力路徑不能直接套到尚未完成的架設狀態。
steps.observationEn: Completed-bridge force paths cannot simply be applied to incomplete erection states.
steps.failure: 完工結構安全就代表每個中間狀態也必然安全。
steps.failureEn: A satisfactory completed structure guarantees every intermediate state.
steps.check: 提交三張有缺件與邊界註記的狀態圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit three state diagrams identifying missing members and boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 施工階段的剛度、約束及荷載都會變動；臨時系統有自己的分析需求。
knowledge.textEn: Construction-stage stiffness, restraints and loads change; temporary systems need their own analysis.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 課程的狀態排序用來檢查依賴關係，不是吊裝作業程序。
knowledge.textEn: The educational state sequence checks dependencies and is not a lifting procedure.

quiz.question: 審查「比較架設前後的受力狀態」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare construction and completed states”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 完工橋的力路徑不能直接套到尚未完成的架設狀態。
完工結構安全就代表每個中間狀態也必然安全。
未安裝的構件仍可在施工模型中提供實際剛度。
optionsEn: Completed-bridge force paths cannot simply be applied to incomplete erection states.
A satisfactory completed structure guarantees every intermediate state.
Uninstalled members still provide actual stiffness in construction models.
quiz.explanation: 施工階段的剛度、約束及荷載都會變動；臨時系統有自己的分析需求。 課程的狀態排序用來檢查依賴關係，不是吊裝作業程序。
quiz.explanationEn: Construction-stage stiffness, restraints and loads change; temporary systems need their own analysis. The educational state sequence checks dependencies and is not a lifting procedure.

steps.title: 追蹤橋面節段幾何累積
steps.objective: 理解局部尺寸誤差與全跨閉合的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate local dimension errors to whole-span closure.
steps.instruction: 1. 排列六個自設長度節段；2. 分別加入同向及交錯誤差；3. 比較末端閉合偏差並記錄基準。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Arrange six hypothetical deck lengths; 2. add same-direction and alternating errors; 3. compare end closure and record the reference frame.
steps.observation: 相同單節誤差上限可能形成不同的累積閉合差。
steps.observationEn: The same per-segment error bound can yield different accumulated closure errors.
steps.failure: 每段誤差不大就不需要檢查整跨累積。
steps.failureEn: Small individual errors eliminate the need to check span-wide accumulation.
steps.check: 輸出節段表、累積曲線及一個可追溯基準。
steps.checkEn: Provide a segment table, accumulation plot and traceable datum.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 系統性偏差會沿序列累積，不能當成互相抵消的隨機誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Systematic bias accumulates along a sequence and cannot be treated as canceling random error.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 幾何比較應指定溫度與模型狀態，避免把環境變化誤認為製作誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Geometry comparisons should specify temperature and model state to avoid mistaking environmental movement for fabrication error.

quiz.question: 審查「追蹤橋面節段幾何累積」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Track accumulated deck-segment geometry”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 每段誤差不大就不需要檢查整跨累積。
相同單節誤差上限可能形成不同的累積閉合差。
相同方向的節段偏差必然互相抵消。
optionsEn: Small individual errors eliminate the need to check span-wide accumulation.
The same per-segment error bound can yield different accumulated closure errors.
Same-direction segment errors necessarily cancel.
quiz.explanation: 系統性偏差會沿序列累積，不能當成互相抵消的隨機誤差。 幾何比較應指定溫度與模型狀態，避免把環境變化誤認為製作誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: Systematic bias accumulates along a sequence and cannot be treated as canceling random error. Geometry comparisons should specify temperature and model state to avoid mistaking environmental movement for fabrication error.

steps.title: 區分橋面彎曲與扭轉
steps.objective: 看出左右側位移組合代表的變形模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify deformation modes from paired edge movements.
steps.instruction: 1. 在同一斷面設左右觀察點；2. 繪同向與反向位移；3. 比較中線升降與斷面轉角。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Place observation points at both deck edges; 2. draw same-direction and opposite-direction movements; 3. compare centerline motion and section rotation.
steps.observation: 兩側反向位移可能代表扭轉而非單純整體升降。
steps.observationEn: Opposite edge movements can indicate torsion rather than uniform vertical motion.
steps.failure: 只量一側橋面即可完整區分所有變形模式。
steps.failureEn: One deck-edge measurement fully distinguishes all deformation modes.
steps.check: 提交兩組邊緣位移及對應的模式標籤。
steps.checkEn: Provide two paired edge-motion cases with mode labels.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 彎曲與扭轉是不同的變形自由度；橋面橫向連接會影響兩者的耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Bending and torsion are distinct degrees of freedom; transverse connections influence their coupling.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 一個感測器的時間曲線不足以唯一判斷整個斷面的運動。
knowledge.textEn: One sensor time history cannot uniquely identify the motion of an entire cross-section.

quiz.question: 審查「區分橋面彎曲與扭轉」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Distinguish deck bending and torsion”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只量一側橋面即可完整區分所有變形模式。
兩側反向位移代表橋面只做剛體平移。
兩側反向位移可能代表扭轉而非單純整體升降。
optionsEn: One deck-edge measurement fully distinguishes all deformation modes.
Opposite edge movements indicate pure rigid translation.
Opposite edge movements can indicate torsion rather than uniform vertical motion.
quiz.explanation: 彎曲與扭轉是不同的變形自由度；橋面橫向連接會影響兩者的耦合。 一個感測器的時間曲線不足以唯一判斷整個斷面的運動。
quiz.explanationEn: Bending and torsion are distinct degrees of freedom; transverse connections influence their coupling. One sensor time history cannot uniquely identify the motion of an entire cross-section.

steps.title: 用風案例比較剛度與阻尼
steps.titleEn: Compare stiffness and damping in wind cases
steps.objective: 避免把降低位移與消耗振動能量混為一談。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid conflating reduced displacement with dissipation of vibration energy.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫兩個自設振動衰減曲線；2. 分別改變頻率及衰減快慢；3. 標註剛度改變與阻尼改變的差別。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw two hypothetical vibration-decay curves; 2. vary frequency and decay rate separately; 3. distinguish stiffness changes from damping changes.
steps.observation: 頻率改變與衰減加快是不同的模型特徵。
steps.observationEn: A changed frequency and faster decay are different model features.
steps.failure: 振幅較小就一定證明材料強度提高。
steps.failureEn: A smaller amplitude necessarily proves higher material strength.
steps.check: 繳交頻率、振幅及衰減三個獨立觀察欄。
steps.checkEn: Provide separate observations for frequency, amplitude and decay.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 剛度影響固有頻率，阻尼描述能量耗散；兩者不能從單一最大振幅直接互換。
knowledge.textEn: Stiffness affects natural frequency while damping describes dissipation; one peak amplitude does not identify both.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 橋梁的風反應還受氣動形狀與來流條件影響，簡單振子只是概念工具。
knowledge.textEn: Bridge wind response also depends on aerodynamics and inflow; a simple oscillator is only a conceptual tool.

quiz.question: 審查「用風案例比較剛度與阻尼」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare stiffness and damping in wind cases”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 頻率改變與衰減加快是不同的模型特徵。
振幅較小就一定證明材料強度提高。
衰減曲線變快就唯一證明固有頻率提高。
optionsEn: A changed frequency and faster decay are different model features.
A smaller amplitude necessarily proves higher material strength.
Faster decay uniquely proves an increased natural frequency.
quiz.explanation: 剛度影響固有頻率，阻尼描述能量耗散；兩者不能從單一最大振幅直接互換。 橋梁的風反應還受氣動形狀與來流條件影響，簡單振子只是概念工具。
quiz.explanationEn: Stiffness affects natural frequency while damping describes dissipation; one peak amplitude does not identify both. Bridge wind response also depends on aerodynamics and inflow; a simple oscillator is only a conceptual tool.

steps.title: 讀取橋面更換的介面變化
steps.objective: 理解更換橋面會改變質量與接合需求。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how deck replacement changes mass and connection requirements.
steps.instruction: 1. 並排畫原混凝土橋面與鋼橋面概念截面；2. 標示重量、局部剛度及排水介面；3. 列出需要重新核對的吊索與支承資料。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Compare conceptual concrete and steel deck sections; 2. mark mass, local stiffness and drainage interfaces; 3. list hanger and support records needing review.
steps.observation: 減輕橋面重量不表示所有結構反應都按同一比例減少。
steps.observationEn: Reduced deck weight does not reduce every structural response by the same proportion.
steps.failure: 換成較輕橋面後即可沿用全部舊的動態與接合判斷。
steps.failureEn: A lighter deck permits every old dynamic and connection assumption to remain unchanged.
steps.check: 輸出更換前後的介面差異清單。
steps.checkEn: Provide an interface-change register for the replacement.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 質量、剛度與載荷分配共同決定反應，改變其中一項便可能需要重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: Mass, stiffness and load distribution jointly govern response; changing one may require reassessment.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方記錄的橋面更換是歷史案例；本練習不重建其夜間施工安排。
knowledge.textEn: The documented deck replacement is a historical case; this exercise does not reconstruct its night-work plan.

quiz.question: 審查「讀取橋面更換的介面變化」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Interpret deck-replacement interfaces”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 換成較輕橋面後即可沿用全部舊的動態與接合判斷。
減輕橋面重量不表示所有結構反應都按同一比例減少。
重量變少就不必再核對任何橋面連接。
optionsEn: A lighter deck permits every old dynamic and connection assumption to remain unchanged.
Reduced deck weight does not reduce every structural response by the same proportion.
Lower weight eliminates every deck-connection recheck.
quiz.explanation: 質量、剛度與載荷分配共同決定反應，改變其中一項便可能需要重新評估。 官方記錄的橋面更換是歷史案例；本練習不重建其夜間施工安排。
quiz.explanationEn: Mass, stiffness and load distribution jointly govern response; changing one may require reassessment. The documented deck replacement is a historical case; this exercise does not reconstruct its night-work plan.

steps.title: 做橋面階段幾何審查
steps.objective: 讓架設狀態與量測資料具有一致版本。
steps.objectiveEn: Keep construction states and measurement data under consistent versions.
steps.instruction: 1. 選一個部分完成狀態；2. 檢查節段、溫度與基準的版本；3. 用新舊兩張圖指出一個不能直接比較的量測。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Select a partially complete state; 2. check segment, temperature and datum versions; 3. identify one observation that cannot be directly compared across two revisions.
steps.observation: 同一位置的讀數在不同邊界條件下不一定可直接相減。
steps.observationEn: Readings at the same location are not necessarily directly comparable under different boundaries.
steps.failure: 測點名稱相同便代表兩次量測具有相同條件。
steps.failureEn: An identical point name guarantees identical measurement conditions.
steps.check: 提交一份帶版本及不適用說明的比較表。
steps.checkEn: Submit a versioned comparison table with applicability notes.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 量測可追溯性包含儀器與模型狀態；只保留數字會丟失工程意義。
knowledge.textEn: Measurement traceability includes instruments and model state; retaining numbers alone loses engineering meaning.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 介面修訂應通知依賴該資料的後續判讀，否則局部正確仍可造成整體不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Interface revisions must propagate to dependent interpretations or locally correct work can remain globally inconsistent.

quiz.question: 審查「做橋面階段幾何審查」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review deck-stage geometry”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 測點名稱相同便代表兩次量測具有相同條件。
測量紀錄只保留數字比保留溫度與版本更完整。
同一位置的讀數在不同邊界條件下不一定可直接相減。
optionsEn: An identical point name guarantees identical measurement conditions.
Numbers alone are a more complete measurement record than numbers with temperature and versions.
Readings at the same location are not necessarily directly comparable under different boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 量測可追溯性包含儀器與模型狀態；只保留數字會丟失工程意義。 介面修訂應通知依賴該資料的後續判讀，否則局部正確仍可造成整體不一致。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurement traceability includes instruments and model state; retaining numbers alone loses engineering meaning. Interface revisions must propagate to dependent interpretations or locally correct work can remain globally inconsistent.

stages.title: 維護、改造與工程移轉
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「維護、改造與工程移轉」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on maintenance, rehabilitation and transfer, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 制定分區腐蝕觀察表
steps.objective: 區分腐蝕環境與可見缺陷的證據層級。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate exposure conditions from observed-defect evidence.
steps.instruction: 1. 在示意橋上分出海霧、排水與接頭區；2. 各列一種可觀察現象；3. 加入照片日期、位置與不可見範圍欄。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Divide a schematic into marine-fog, drainage and joint zones; 2. list one observable condition per zone; 3. add photo date, location and unseen-scope fields.
steps.observation: 相同外觀缺陷在不同排水與暴露條件下可能有不同進展。
steps.observationEn: Similar visible defects can progress differently under different drainage and exposure conditions.
steps.failure: 只用照片顏色就判定剩餘承載能力。
steps.failureEn: Infer remaining load capacity from photograph color alone.
steps.check: 提交分區觀察表並標示不能由照片推出的結論。
steps.checkEn: Provide a zoned observation register and conclusions photographs cannot establish.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 腐蝕評估需連接環境、材料損失與構件功能；外觀是證據的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion assessment links exposure, material loss and function; appearance supplies only part of the evidence.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 照片適合做位置與變化追蹤，但沒有比例與時間基準時不能直接量化損失。
knowledge.textEn: Photos track location and change, but cannot quantify loss without scale and time references.

quiz.question: 審查「制定分區腐蝕觀察表」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Create a corrosion-observation map”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 相同外觀缺陷在不同排水與暴露條件下可能有不同進展。
只用照片顏色就判定剩餘承載能力。
所有暴露區都能由同一張近照推定腐蝕狀態。
optionsEn: Similar visible defects can progress differently under different drainage and exposure conditions.
Infer remaining load capacity from photograph color alone.
One close-up establishes corrosion conditions in every exposure zone.
quiz.explanation: 腐蝕評估需連接環境、材料損失與構件功能；外觀是證據的一部分。 照片適合做位置與變化追蹤，但沒有比例與時間基準時不能直接量化損失。
quiz.explanationEn: Corrosion assessment links exposure, material loss and function; appearance supplies only part of the evidence. Photos track location and change, but cannot quantify loss without scale and time references.

steps.title: 拆解吊索更新的依賴關係
steps.objective: 看出構件更換前後的負載轉移問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize load-transfer questions around component replacement.
steps.instruction: 1. 在模型標示待更新吊索；2. 畫出可能受影響的相鄰橋面區；3. 列出臨時狀態分析與復核紀錄兩類先決證據。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Mark a hypothetical renewal hanger; 2. map adjacent deck areas potentially affected; 3. list temporary-state analysis and verification records as prerequisites.
steps.observation: 更換一個局部承重元件會影響鄰近系統的受力與幾何。
steps.observationEn: Replacing one local load-bearing element affects neighboring forces and geometry.
steps.failure: 零件尺寸相同就可忽略更換時的負載轉移。
steps.failureEn: Matching component dimensions makes load transfer during replacement irrelevant.
steps.check: 輸出依賴圖，明確區分概念審查與現場作業。
steps.checkEn: Produce a dependency map distinguishing conceptual review from field work.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 承重構件不能被視為隨意可抽換的積木，臨時平衡也是設計問題。
knowledge.textEn: Load-bearing components are not freely removable blocks; temporary equilibrium is a design question.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 歷史更新案例可提示應查哪些證據，但不提供今天可直接照做的工序。
knowledge.textEn: Historical renewal cases suggest evidence needs but do not supply present-day executable procedures.

quiz.question: 審查「拆解吊索更新的依賴關係」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Map hanger-renewal dependencies”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 零件尺寸相同就可忽略更換時的負載轉移。
更換一個局部承重元件會影響鄰近系統的受力與幾何。
吊索更換只影響新吊索，不影響鄰近橋面。
optionsEn: Matching component dimensions makes load transfer during replacement irrelevant.
Replacing one local load-bearing element affects neighboring forces and geometry.
Hanger replacement affects only the new hanger, not adjacent deck areas.
quiz.explanation: 承重構件不能被視為隨意可抽換的積木，臨時平衡也是設計問題。 歷史更新案例可提示應查哪些證據，但不提供今天可直接照做的工序。
quiz.explanationEn: Load-bearing components are not freely removable blocks; temporary equilibrium is a design question. Historical renewal cases suggest evidence needs but do not supply present-day executable procedures.

steps.title: 建立耐震改造的性能矩陣
steps.objective: 區分構件加強、位移容許及能量耗散。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish strengthening, movement accommodation and energy dissipation.
steps.instruction: 1. 列出橋塔、橋面連接及引橋；2. 對每項寫下力、位移與功能問題；3. 比較三種概念改造目的而不設定實橋參數。
steps.instructionEn: 1. List towers, deck connections and approaches; 2. identify force, displacement and function questions; 3. compare three rehabilitation aims without assigning real-bridge settings.
steps.observation: 更強的局部構件可能把更多地震作用傳到相鄰介面。
steps.observationEn: A stronger local member can transfer more seismic demand into adjacent interfaces.
steps.failure: 提高局部剛度就保證整座橋所有部位的需求都降低。
steps.failureEn: Increasing local stiffness guarantees lower demand everywhere in the bridge.
steps.check: 繳交性能目標、介面影響與查證方式的矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Submit a matrix of performance aims, interface effects and verification methods.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 耐震性能同時包含強度、變形能力與功能維持；單一安全係數不能描述全部。
knowledge.textEn: Seismic performance involves strength, deformation capacity and function; one safety factor cannot describe all of it.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 營運者的分期改造提供案例背景，課程不宣稱任一期在今天已完工。
knowledge.textEn: The operator’s phased rehabilitation provides context; this course makes no claim that a particular phase is complete today.

quiz.question: 審查「建立耐震改造的性能矩陣」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Build a seismic-performance matrix”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 提高局部剛度就保證整座橋所有部位的需求都降低。
能量耗散與局部材料強度是完全相同的性能量。
更強的局部構件可能把更多地震作用傳到相鄰介面。
optionsEn: Increasing local stiffness guarantees lower demand everywhere in the bridge.
Energy dissipation and local material strength are identical performance quantities.
A stronger local member can transfer more seismic demand into adjacent interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 耐震性能同時包含強度、變形能力與功能維持；單一安全係數不能描述全部。 營運者的分期改造提供案例背景，課程不宣稱任一期在今天已完工。
quiz.explanationEn: Seismic performance involves strength, deformation capacity and function; one safety factor cannot describe all of it. The operator’s phased rehabilitation provides context; this course makes no claim that a particular phase is complete today.

steps.title: 辨識量測漂移與結構變化
steps.titleEn: Distinguish sensor drift from structural change
steps.objective: 避免把單一異常訊號當成唯一原因。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating a single anomalous signal as a unique diagnosis.
steps.instruction: 1. 自設兩個位移與一個溫度序列；2. 加入單點偏移及共同趨勢；3. 列出交叉感測與基準複測的查證次序。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create two displacement series and one temperature series; 2. add a single-point offset and shared trend; 3. define cross-sensor and datum rechecks.
steps.observation: 多個獨立訊號的一致趨勢比單點跳動更能支持系統性變化。
steps.observationEn: Consistent trends across independent signals support system-wide change better than one jump.
steps.failure: 任何超出過去範圍的數字都能直接定位受損構件。
steps.failureEn: Any reading outside its historical range directly identifies a damaged component.
steps.check: 提交包含至少兩個替代解釋的異常判讀單。
steps.checkEn: Submit an anomaly review with at least two alternative explanations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 感測器漂移、環境影響與真實變形都可能產生異常；需辨識而非只報警。
knowledge.textEn: Sensor drift, environmental effects and real deformation can all create anomalies; interpretation is needed beyond an alarm.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設數據只能驗證判讀方法，不能估計真橋的當前健康狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic data test interpretation methods and cannot estimate the actual bridge’s current condition.

quiz.question: 審查「辨識量測漂移與結構變化」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Distinguish sensor drift from structural change”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 多個獨立訊號的一致趨勢比單點跳動更能支持系統性變化。
任何超出過去範圍的數字都能直接定位受損構件。
同一感測器重複輸出的數字就等同多個獨立證據。
optionsEn: Consistent trends across independent signals support system-wide change better than one jump.
Any reading outside its historical range directly identifies a damaged component.
Repeated output from one sensor equals multiple independent evidence sources.
quiz.explanation: 感測器漂移、環境影響與真實變形都可能產生異常；需辨識而非只報警。 自設數據只能驗證判讀方法，不能估計真橋的當前健康狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: Sensor drift, environmental effects and real deformation can all create anomalies; interpretation is needed beyond an alarm. Synthetic data test interpretation methods and cannot estimate the actual bridge’s current condition.

steps.title: 比較明石海峽與淡江大橋
steps.titleEn: Compare Akashi Kaikyo and Danjiang bridges
steps.objective: 辨認可轉移工法與不可直接移植的假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify transferable methods and nontransferable assumptions.
steps.instruction: 1. 並排畫金門、明石與淡江橋型；2. 對比主纜吊索與斜張索力路徑；3. 列出場址、風與基礎必須重新查證的差異。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch Golden Gate, Akashi Kaikyo and Danjiang forms; 2. contrast main-cable/hanger and stay force paths; 3. list site, wind and foundation differences needing new evidence.
steps.observation: 量測追溯與介面審查可轉移，但橋型和場址參數須重新建立。
steps.observationEn: Measurement traceability and interface review transfer, but bridge form and site parameters require rebuilding.
steps.failure: 同為跨水大橋便能沿用同一組索力與基礎條件。
steps.failureEn: Every water-crossing bridge can reuse identical cable forces and foundation conditions.
steps.check: 繳交三項相似處與三項禁止直接套用的差異。
steps.checkEn: Provide three similarities and three differences that prevent direct reuse.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 比較工程的價值在辨認相同問題的不同解法，不在尋找外觀最相近的照片。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering comparison identifies different solutions to related problems rather than merely similar photographs.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 懸索與斜張橋都需幾何及張力協調，但力路徑和施工狀態不同。
knowledge.textEn: Suspension and cable-stayed bridges both coordinate geometry and tension but have different force paths and construction states.

quiz.question: 審查「比較明石海峽與淡江大橋」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare Akashi Kaikyo and Danjiang bridges”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 同為跨水大橋便能沿用同一組索力與基礎條件。
量測追溯與介面審查可轉移，但橋型和場址參數須重新建立。
不同場址的風與地質條件可由橋梁外觀相似程度換算。
optionsEn: Every water-crossing bridge can reuse identical cable forces and foundation conditions.
Measurement traceability and interface review transfer, but bridge form and site parameters require rebuilding.
Visual similarity between bridges determines corresponding wind and ground conditions.
quiz.explanation: 比較工程的價值在辨認相同問題的不同解法，不在尋找外觀最相近的照片。 懸索與斜張橋都需幾何及張力協調，但力路徑和施工狀態不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Engineering comparison identifies different solutions to related problems rather than merely similar photographs. Suspension and cable-stayed bridges both coordinate geometry and tension but have different force paths and construction states.

steps.title: 總工程師交付證據包
steps.objective: 把完整課程整理成可複查的工程論證。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the course into an auditable engineering argument.
steps.instruction: 1. 彙整場址、受力、狀態及維護圖；2. 給每個結論連上一個來源或模型假設；3. 保留三個仍需專業調查才能回答的問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Assemble site, force, state and maintenance diagrams; 2. attach a source or model assumption to every conclusion; 3. retain three questions requiring professional investigation.
steps.observation: 完整交付包含未解問題和適用範圍，而非只有通過標記。
steps.observationEn: A complete handover includes unresolved questions and applicability limits, not just pass marks.
steps.failure: 課程操作完成就等於具備現地橋梁施工資格。
steps.failureEn: Completing the course establishes qualification to construct a real bridge.
steps.check: 提交帶版本、來源及限制的四頁概念工程包。
steps.checkEn: Submit a four-page conceptual engineering pack with versions, sources and limits.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 工程論證由要求、模型、證據及限制串起來；漂亮圖面本身不是驗證。
knowledge.textEn: An engineering argument joins requirements, models, evidence and limits; a polished diagram is not verification.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本課程完成的是概念與證據組織能力，不是金門大橋的原始施工設計。
knowledge.textEn: This course develops conceptual and evidence-organizing skills, not the Golden Gate Bridge’s original construction design.

quiz.question: 審查「總工程師交付證據包」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Deliver the chief-engineer evidence pack”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 課程操作完成就等於具備現地橋梁施工資格。
未解問題應從交付資料刪除，以免影響完整性。
完整交付包含未解問題和適用範圍，而非只有通過標記。
optionsEn: Completing the course establishes qualification to construct a real bridge.
Open questions should be removed from handover records to preserve completeness.
A complete handover includes unresolved questions and applicability limits, not just pass marks.
quiz.explanation: 工程論證由要求、模型、證據及限制串起來；漂亮圖面本身不是驗證。 本課程完成的是概念與證據組織能力，不是金門大橋的原始施工設計。
quiz.explanationEn: An engineering argument joins requirements, models, evidence and limits; a polished diagram is not verification. This course develops conceptual and evidence-organizing skills, not the Golden Gate Bridge’s original construction design.

courses.title: 台北 101
courses.summary: 用 24 步拆解超高層建築的核心、外伸桁架、基礎、風振控制與營運介面，將外觀地標轉成可解釋的工程系統。
courses.summaryEn: Use 24 steps to unpack the core, outriggers, foundations, wind-motion control and operating interfaces of a supertall building.
courses.scope: 以公開一次資料為背景的原創工程判讀課程；每步在紙上或數位示意模型中完成。自設數值、構形與工序不得當成原工程的設計、施工、設備操作或驗收程序。
courses.scopeEn: Original engineering interpretation exercises grounded in public primary sources. Complete each step on paper or in a schematic digital model. Invented values, geometry and sequences are not the original project’s design, construction, operating or acceptance procedures.

stages.title: 需求、場址與荷載
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「需求、場址與荷載」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on requirements, site and loads, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 分清高度與使用需求
steps.objective: 把地標高度轉成結構與使用性能問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Translate landmark height into structural and service-performance questions.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫辦公、機械及觀景用途區；2. 分列承載、舒適與維護需求；3. 為每類寫一種需要的證據。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch office, mechanical and observation zones; 2. separate capacity, comfort and maintenance needs; 3. name evidence for each.
steps.observation: 足夠承載能力不會自動保證高樓使用者感到舒適。
steps.observationEn: Adequate load capacity does not automatically establish occupant comfort.
steps.failure: 只以總高度判定建築性能是否良好。
steps.failureEn: Assess building performance from total height alone.
steps.check: 提交三類需求和對應證據矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Submit a matrix of three requirement classes and their evidence.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 極限承載與日常服務性能回答不同問題，風中加速度常與使用感受有關。
knowledge.textEn: Ultimate capacity and everyday serviceability answer different questions; wind acceleration can matter to occupants.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 建築高度是幾何背景，不是風、地震或舒適性能的直接評分。
knowledge.textEn: Building height is geometric context, not a direct wind, seismic or comfort score.

quiz.question: 審查「分清高度與使用需求」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate height from functional requirements”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 足夠承載能力不會自動保證高樓使用者感到舒適。
只以總高度判定建築性能是否良好。
一棟樓有足夠承載能力就不會產生令人不適的加速度。
optionsEn: Adequate load capacity does not automatically establish occupant comfort.
Assess building performance from total height alone.
Adequate capacity guarantees absence of uncomfortable acceleration.
quiz.explanation: 極限承載與日常服務性能回答不同問題，風中加速度常與使用感受有關。 建築高度是幾何背景，不是風、地震或舒適性能的直接評分。
quiz.explanationEn: Ultimate capacity and everyday serviceability answer different questions; wind acceleration can matter to occupants. Building height is geometric context, not a direct wind, seismic or comfort score.

steps.title: 標記都市場址介面
steps.objective: 理解基地邊界以外仍有工程依賴。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand dependencies beyond the property boundary.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫基地、周邊道路及鄰房；2. 標示地下水與管線資料空白；3. 區分公開地址、假設範圍與待調查範圍。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch site, roads and neighboring buildings; 2. mark gaps in groundwater and utility knowledge; 3. distinguish the public address, assumptions and investigation scope.
steps.observation: 精確街址不能取代地下管線及地層調查。
steps.observationEn: A precise street address does not replace utility and ground investigation.
steps.failure: Google 地圖看到建築輪廓便可推知地下基礎範圍。
steps.failureEn: A visible building outline on Google Maps establishes its underground foundation extent.
steps.check: 輸出含三個地下未知項的基地圖。
steps.checkEn: Produce a site plan with three underground unknowns.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 深基礎與地下室的變形或水位影響可能跨越地籍邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Deep-foundation and basement deformation or water effects can extend beyond cadastral boundaries.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 公開地圖適合建立背景與方位，不能當作現地測量控制資料。
knowledge.textEn: Public maps establish context and orientation, not field survey control.

quiz.question: 審查「標記都市場址介面」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Map urban-site interfaces”, which interpretation is justified?
options: Google 地圖看到建築輪廓便可推知地下基礎範圍。
精確街址不能取代地下管線及地層調查。
地下室與基礎的影響必然止於地籍邊界。
optionsEn: A visible building outline on Google Maps establishes its underground foundation extent.
A precise street address does not replace utility and ground investigation.
Basement and foundation effects necessarily stop at cadastral boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 深基礎與地下室的變形或水位影響可能跨越地籍邊界。 公開地圖適合建立背景與方位，不能當作現地測量控制資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Deep-foundation and basement deformation or water effects can extend beyond cadastral boundaries. Public maps establish context and orientation, not field survey control.

steps.title: 區分重力與水平力路徑
steps.titleEn: Separate gravity and lateral force paths
steps.objective: 把樓板、核心與周邊柱接成不同力路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect floors, core and perimeter columns through distinct force paths.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一個概念標準層；2. 以兩色分別追蹤重力及水平力；3. 在基礎處關閉兩條反力路徑。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a conceptual typical floor; 2. trace gravity and lateral forces in two colors; 3. close both reaction paths at foundations.
steps.observation: 同一樓板可以同時承受重力並傳遞平面內水平作用。
steps.observationEn: A floor can support gravity and transmit in-plane lateral action simultaneously.
steps.failure: 重力傳到柱子後就不需要考慮樓板的水平傳力。
steps.failureEn: Once gravity reaches columns, floor-level lateral transfer can be ignored.
steps.check: 提交包含樓板平面內作用的雙色受力圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a two-color force map including floor in-plane action.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 樓板作為水平傳力構件時需要足夠連接；畫成剛性平面是一種模型假設。
knowledge.textEn: Floors require connections to transfer lateral action; drawing a rigid diaphragm is a modeling assumption.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 核心、周邊框架與基礎的分工取決於整體配置，不能從立面照片唯一推導。
knowledge.textEn: The roles of core, perimeter framing and foundations depend on the system and cannot be uniquely inferred from a façade photo.

quiz.question: 審查「區分重力與水平力路徑」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate gravity and lateral force paths”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 重力傳到柱子後就不需要考慮樓板的水平傳力。
樓板的平面內作用與其連接條件完全無關。
同一樓板可以同時承受重力並傳遞平面內水平作用。
optionsEn: Once gravity reaches columns, floor-level lateral transfer can be ignored.
In-plane floor action is entirely independent of connections.
A floor can support gravity and transmit in-plane lateral action simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 樓板作為水平傳力構件時需要足夠連接；畫成剛性平面是一種模型假設。 核心、周邊框架與基礎的分工取決於整體配置，不能從立面照片唯一推導。
quiz.explanationEn: Floors require connections to transfer lateral action; drawing a rigid diaphragm is a modeling assumption. The roles of core, perimeter framing and foundations depend on the system and cannot be uniquely inferred from a façade photo.

steps.title: 拆出質量、剛度與阻尼
steps.objective: 建立高樓振動的最小概念模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a minimal conceptual model of tall-building motion.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫單自由度質量彈簧模型；2. 分別改變一個無量綱參數；3. 比較頻率及衰減形狀。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a one-degree-of-freedom mass-spring model; 2. change one dimensionless parameter at a time; 3. compare frequency and decay shape.
steps.observation: 增加質量與增加剛度通常對頻率產生不同方向的影響。
steps.observationEn: Increasing mass and increasing stiffness generally shift frequency in different directions.
steps.failure: 只看振幅較小便確定質量、剛度與阻尼都提高。
steps.failureEn: A smaller amplitude proves that mass, stiffness and damping all increased.
steps.check: 繳交三個單參數變更的對照圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide three comparisons changing one parameter at a time.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 理想線性振子頻率與剛度和質量的比值有關，阻尼控制能量消散。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal linear-oscillator frequency depends on stiffness relative to mass; damping governs dissipation.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 單自由度模型省略高階與扭轉模態，只適合說明機理。
knowledge.textEn: A one-degree model omits higher and torsional modes and is suitable only for explaining mechanisms.

quiz.question: 審查「拆出質量、剛度與阻尼」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate mass, stiffness and damping”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 增加質量與增加剛度通常對頻率產生不同方向的影響。
只看振幅較小便確定質量、剛度與阻尼都提高。
剛度加倍一定使理想振子的頻率加倍。
optionsEn: Increasing mass and increasing stiffness generally shift frequency in different directions.
A smaller amplitude proves that mass, stiffness and damping all increased.
Doubling stiffness necessarily doubles ideal oscillator frequency.
quiz.explanation: 理想線性振子頻率與剛度和質量的比值有關，阻尼控制能量消散。 單自由度模型省略高階與扭轉模態，只適合說明機理。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal linear-oscillator frequency depends on stiffness relative to mass; damping governs dissipation. A one-degree model omits higher and torsional modes and is suitable only for explaining mechanisms.

steps.title: 比較風與地震輸入
steps.objective: 辨認外力激振與基底運動的差別。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish applied-force excitation from base motion.
steps.instruction: 1. 在樓身畫風作用分布；2. 在基礎畫假想地盤移動；3. 列出兩情境不同的輸入與輸出量。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw wind actions along the tower; 2. draw hypothetical ground movement at the base; 3. list distinct inputs and outputs for both cases.
steps.observation: 風與地震都能引起振動，但輸入位置與時間特徵不同。
steps.observationEn: Wind and earthquakes both induce motion but differ in input location and time characteristics.
steps.failure: 兩者最大位移相同就代表每層受力及使用感受相同。
steps.failureEn: Equal peak displacement implies equal story forces and occupant experience.
steps.check: 提交兩個輸入—系統—觀察量的方塊圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit two input–system–observation diagrams.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 外力與基底運動使用不同邊界描述；比較時必須先對齊量的定義。
knowledge.textEn: Applied forces and base motion use different boundary descriptions; comparisons require aligned definitions.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本練習不把任一自設時程當成台北 101 的設計地震或風場。
knowledge.textEn: No synthetic time history in this exercise is a Taipei 101 design earthquake or wind field.

quiz.question: 審查「比較風與地震輸入」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare wind and earthquake inputs”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 兩者最大位移相同就代表每層受力及使用感受相同。
風與地震都能引起振動，但輸入位置與時間特徵不同。
地震輸入只能畫成樓頂的一個靜態水平力。
optionsEn: Equal peak displacement implies equal story forces and occupant experience.
Wind and earthquakes both induce motion but differ in input location and time characteristics.
Earthquake input can only be represented by one static roof force.
quiz.explanation: 外力與基底運動使用不同邊界描述；比較時必須先對齊量的定義。 本練習不把任一自設時程當成台北 101 的設計地震或風場。
quiz.explanationEn: Applied forces and base motion use different boundary descriptions; comparisons require aligned definitions. No synthetic time history in this exercise is a Taipei 101 design earthquake or wind field.

steps.title: 審查地基與結構需求
steps.objective: 把上部結構反力連接到基礎證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect superstructure reactions to foundation evidence.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫壓力、拔力及水平反力箭頭；2. 對應樁、承台及地層概念區；3. 分開承載與沉陷兩類問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw compression, uplift and horizontal reactions; 2. connect them to conceptual piles, caps and strata; 3. separate capacity from settlement questions.
steps.observation: 足夠承載與可接受差異沉陷是兩個不同檢查。
steps.observationEn: Adequate capacity and acceptable differential settlement are separate checks.
steps.failure: 樁數足夠就能忽略群樁及沉陷差異。
steps.failureEn: A sufficient pile count makes group effects and differential settlement irrelevant.
steps.check: 輸出一張反力對證據需求的配對表。
steps.checkEn: Produce a reaction-to-evidence matching table.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 基礎設計需處理荷載分配與變形相容；不能只將總重除以樁數。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation design addresses load distribution and deformation compatibility, not simply total weight divided by pile count.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方基礎概要提供系統背景，不提供可用於新基地的承載設計值。
knowledge.textEn: The owner’s foundation overview supplies system context, not bearing design values for another site.

quiz.question: 審查「審查地基與結構需求」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review ground and structural requirements”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 樁數足夠就能忽略群樁及沉陷差異。
總重除以樁數即可完整預測每根樁的受力與沉陷。
足夠承載與可接受差異沉陷是兩個不同檢查。
optionsEn: A sufficient pile count makes group effects and differential settlement irrelevant.
Total weight divided by pile count fully predicts each pile’s load and settlement.
Adequate capacity and acceptable differential settlement are separate checks.
quiz.explanation: 基礎設計需處理荷載分配與變形相容；不能只將總重除以樁數。 官方基礎概要提供系統背景，不提供可用於新基地的承載設計值。
quiz.explanationEn: Foundation design addresses load distribution and deformation compatibility, not simply total weight divided by pile count. The owner’s foundation overview supplies system context, not bearing design values for another site.

stages.title: 核心、外伸桁架與介面
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「核心、外伸桁架與介面」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on core, outriggers and interfaces, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 辨認斜撐核心系統
steps.objective: 將核心視為具有連接與變形的結構。
steps.objectiveEn: Treat the core as a structure with connections and deformation.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心框架與假想斜撐；2. 標記軸力及層間側移；3. 比較連接完整與鬆開的概念模型。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Sketch core framing and conceptual braces; 2. mark axial forces and story drift; 3. compare connected and released idealized models.
steps.observation: 核心的側向作用依賴構件與連接共同形成傳力系統。
steps.observationEn: Core lateral action depends on members and connections forming a continuous system.
steps.failure: 只要核心外框封閉就一定具有相同剛度。
steps.failureEn: Any closed core outline necessarily has identical stiffness.
steps.check: 提供構件、連接與層間位移三種標記。
steps.checkEn: Provide member, connection and story-drift annotations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 斜撐利用軸向作用參與側向抵抗，但連接假設會改變整體變形。
knowledge.textEn: Braces participate through axial action, while connection assumptions affect overall deformation.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 示意模型不還原實樓所有斜撐位置，細節須由工程圖及專業分析確認。
knowledge.textEn: The schematic does not reproduce every real brace location; details require engineering drawings and analysis.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認斜撐核心系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Identify the braced core”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 核心的側向作用依賴構件與連接共同形成傳力系統。
只要核心外框封閉就一定具有相同剛度。
核心構件只要存在，連接方式就不影響變形。
optionsEn: Core lateral action depends on members and connections forming a continuous system.
Any closed core outline necessarily has identical stiffness.
Core-member presence makes connection details irrelevant to deformation.
quiz.explanation: 斜撐利用軸向作用參與側向抵抗，但連接假設會改變整體變形。 示意模型不還原實樓所有斜撐位置，細節須由工程圖及專業分析確認。
quiz.explanationEn: Braces participate through axial action, while connection assumptions affect overall deformation. The schematic does not reproduce every real brace location; details require engineering drawings and analysis.

steps.title: 理解外伸桁架如何連接周邊柱
steps.objective: 追蹤核心傾轉與周邊軸力的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Trace the relationship between core rotation and perimeter axial forces.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心、外伸桁架及兩側柱；2. 施加小幅概念側移；3. 標記兩側柱軸力增減及基礎反力。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a core, outrigger and two perimeter columns; 2. apply a small conceptual sway; 3. mark changes in column axial forces and foundation reactions.
steps.observation: 外伸桁架透過周邊柱的軸向作用協助抵抗核心傾轉。
steps.observationEn: An outrigger engages perimeter-column axial action to help resist core rotation.
steps.failure: 外伸桁架只承受自重，不影響周邊柱的受力。
steps.failureEn: An outrigger carries only its own weight and does not affect perimeter-column forces.
steps.check: 提交可追蹤到基礎的外伸桁架力路徑。
steps.checkEn: Submit an outrigger force path traceable to foundations.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 增加有效抵抗力臂可以改變抗傾覆分工，但必須包含連接與基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Engaging a wider resisting lever arm changes overturning resistance but must include connections and foundations.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 台北 101 的多層外伸系統有特定配置；本模型只是解釋作用原理。
knowledge.textEn: Taipei 101 has a specific multi-outrigger layout; this model only explains the mechanism.

quiz.question: 審查「理解外伸桁架如何連接周邊柱」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Understand outrigger-to-perimeter coupling”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 外伸桁架只承受自重，不影響周邊柱的受力。
外伸桁架透過周邊柱的軸向作用協助抵抗核心傾轉。
外伸桁架不需要把作用追蹤到基礎。
optionsEn: An outrigger carries only its own weight and does not affect perimeter-column forces.
An outrigger engages perimeter-column axial action to help resist core rotation.
Outrigger action need not be traced to foundations.
quiz.explanation: 增加有效抵抗力臂可以改變抗傾覆分工，但必須包含連接與基礎。 台北 101 的多層外伸系統有特定配置；本模型只是解釋作用原理。
quiz.explanationEn: Engaging a wider resisting lever arm changes overturning resistance but must include connections and foundations. Taipei 101 has a specific multi-outrigger layout; this model only explains the mechanism.

steps.title: 核對機械層的多系統介面
steps.objective: 辨識設備、結構與維修空間的衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify conflicts among equipment, structure and maintenance space.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一層概念機械層；2. 疊放桁架、管線及維修通道；3. 為每個相交處建立介面問題卡。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a conceptual mechanical floor; 2. overlay trusses, services and maintenance routes; 3. create an interface issue card at each conflict.
steps.observation: 管線能穿過圖面空白不代表現場具有維修及結構許可空間。
steps.observationEn: A service passing through blank drawing space does not establish maintenance clearance or structural permission.
steps.failure: 只檢查設備外框不相交就能完成機械層協調。
steps.failureEn: Nonintersecting equipment outlines alone complete mechanical-floor coordination.
steps.check: 提交至少三個介面衝突及其責任資料欄。
steps.checkEn: Submit at least three interface conflicts with responsible-data fields.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 結構及設備系統共用空間，維護可達性與施工順序也是介面條件。
knowledge.textEn: Structure and services share space; maintenance access and construction sequence are interface conditions too.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 數位碰撞檢查能找幾何衝突，但不能自行批准結構開孔。
knowledge.textEn: Digital clash detection finds geometric conflicts but cannot authorize structural penetrations.

quiz.question: 審查「核對機械層的多系統介面」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Audit mechanical-floor interfaces”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只檢查設備外框不相交就能完成機械層協調。
維修人員所需空間不是設備與結構協調的一部分。
管線能穿過圖面空白不代表現場具有維修及結構許可空間。
optionsEn: Nonintersecting equipment outlines alone complete mechanical-floor coordination.
Maintenance access is outside structural-equipment coordination.
A service passing through blank drawing space does not establish maintenance clearance or structural permission.
quiz.explanation: 結構及設備系統共用空間，維護可達性與施工順序也是介面條件。 數位碰撞檢查能找幾何衝突，但不能自行批准結構開孔。
quiz.explanationEn: Structure and services share space; maintenance access and construction sequence are interface conditions too. Digital clash detection finds geometric conflicts but cannot authorize structural penetrations.

steps.title: 比較周邊框架與核心分工
steps.objective: 避免將所有水平荷載只分配給核心。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid assigning every lateral action to the core alone.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫核心及周邊兩個平行子系統；2. 分別設定相對軟硬的示意值；3. 比較分力與變形相容條件。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw core and perimeter as parallel subsystems; 2. assign illustrative relative stiffnesses; 3. compare load sharing and deformation compatibility.
steps.observation: 相連子系統的相對剛度會影響分力，而非只看構件數量。
steps.observationEn: Relative stiffness of connected subsystems affects force sharing, not merely member count.
steps.failure: 核心較粗就能將周邊框架在模型中全部刪除。
steps.failureEn: A large core justifies deleting all perimeter framing from the model.
steps.check: 輸出兩種剛度比例下的定性分力圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide qualitative force-sharing diagrams for two stiffness ratios.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 相容變形與力平衡必須同時滿足；各系統不能獨立任意分配荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Deformation compatibility and force equilibrium must hold together; loads cannot be assigned arbitrarily to isolated systems.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 設計者的系統概要可指引模型邊界，但不提供完整分析矩陣。
knowledge.textEn: The designer’s system overview guides model boundaries but does not supply a full analysis matrix.

quiz.question: 審查「比較周邊框架與核心分工」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare perimeter-frame and core roles”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 相連子系統的相對剛度會影響分力，而非只看構件數量。
核心較粗就能將周邊框架在模型中全部刪除。
周邊框架與核心可以各自任意分配水平荷載。
optionsEn: Relative stiffness of connected subsystems affects force sharing, not merely member count.
A large core justifies deleting all perimeter framing from the model.
Perimeter frames and core can allocate lateral loads arbitrarily and independently.
quiz.explanation: 相容變形與力平衡必須同時滿足；各系統不能獨立任意分配荷載。 設計者的系統概要可指引模型邊界，但不提供完整分析矩陣。
quiz.explanationEn: Deformation compatibility and force equilibrium must hold together; loads cannot be assigned arbitrarily to isolated systems. The designer’s system overview guides model boundaries but does not supply a full analysis matrix.

steps.title: 檢查樓板開口的傳力繞道
steps.titleEn: Review load paths around floor openings
steps.objective: 理解管道及電梯開口對傳力的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how service and elevator openings affect force transfer.
steps.instruction: 1. 在概念樓板畫兩個開口；2. 繪出繞過開口的平面內力路徑；3. 標記需要連接細節的邊緣。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw two openings in a conceptual floor; 2. trace in-plane force paths around them; 3. identify edges needing connection details.
steps.observation: 局部開口可能改變傳力集中位置，不能只扣除面積。
steps.observationEn: An opening can change force concentration locations rather than simply subtract area.
steps.failure: 樓板總面積差不多便代表開口位置不重要。
steps.failureEn: Similar total floor area makes opening location irrelevant.
steps.check: 提交含邊緣與連接需求的樓板力路徑圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit a floor force-path map with edge and connection needs.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水平傳力須繞過不連續處，幾何與連接決定可用路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral force transfer must bypass discontinuities; geometry and connections determine available paths.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本步示意開口是教學自設，不是台北 101 的實際樓層平面。
knowledge.textEn: Openings in this exercise are invented teaching geometry, not an actual Taipei 101 floor plan.

quiz.question: 審查「檢查樓板開口的傳力繞道」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review load paths around floor openings”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 樓板總面積差不多便代表開口位置不重要。
局部開口可能改變傳力集中位置，不能只扣除面積。
相同開口總面積保證相同的局部傳力路徑。
optionsEn: Similar total floor area makes opening location irrelevant.
An opening can change force concentration locations rather than simply subtract area.
Equal total opening area guarantees identical local force paths.
quiz.explanation: 水平傳力須繞過不連續處，幾何與連接決定可用路徑。 本步示意開口是教學自設，不是台北 101 的實際樓層平面。
quiz.explanationEn: Lateral force transfer must bypass discontinuities; geometry and connections determine available paths. Openings in this exercise are invented teaching geometry, not an actual Taipei 101 floor plan.

steps.title: 用介面矩陣完成結構複核
steps.objective: 讓核心、桁架、樓板與基礎使用一致假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Align assumptions across core, outriggers, floors and foundations.
steps.instruction: 1. 列出四類子系統；2. 每對介面填入力、位移及資料版本；3. 將一個矛盾假設回溯到受影響的步驟。
steps.instructionEn: 1. List four subsystem classes; 2. record forces, movements and data versions at each interface; 3. trace one inconsistent assumption to affected steps.
steps.observation: 單一子系統看似合理仍可能與相鄰系統的邊界不一致。
steps.observationEn: A plausible subsystem may still conflict with adjacent boundary assumptions.
steps.failure: 各張圖都沒有畫錯元件就表示整體模型一定相容。
steps.failureEn: Correctly drawn components on every sheet guarantee global compatibility.
steps.check: 繳交一份包含修訂紀錄的四系統矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Provide a four-system matrix with a revision record.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 工程介面需要雙方共享相同的力與位移定義，否則資料無法直接串接。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering interfaces require shared force and movement definitions for usable data exchange.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 複核應記錄哪些下游結論需要重做，不能只修改衝突那一張圖。
knowledge.textEn: Review records should identify downstream conclusions needing revision, not only the conflicting drawing.

quiz.question: 審查「用介面矩陣完成結構複核」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Complete a structural-interface review”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 各張圖都沒有畫錯元件就表示整體模型一定相容。
不同專業採用不同位移定義不影響介面資料交換。
單一子系統看似合理仍可能與相鄰系統的邊界不一致。
optionsEn: Correctly drawn components on every sheet guarantee global compatibility.
Different displacement definitions do not affect interface data exchange.
A plausible subsystem may still conflict with adjacent boundary assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 工程介面需要雙方共享相同的力與位移定義，否則資料無法直接串接。 複核應記錄哪些下游結論需要重做，不能只修改衝突那一張圖。
quiz.explanationEn: Engineering interfaces require shared force and movement definitions for usable data exchange. Review records should identify downstream conclusions needing revision, not only the conflicting drawing.

stages.title: 風振、量測與機電
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「風振、量測與機電」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on wind motion, measurement and services, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 畫出調諧質量阻尼器雙系統
steps.objective: 區分建築本體與輔助質量的相對運動。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish building motion from auxiliary-mass relative motion.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫建築與懸吊質量兩個自由度；2. 標示兩者位移及相對位移；3. 畫出阻尼作用連接的位置。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw building and suspended-mass degrees of freedom; 2. mark both displacements and their relative displacement; 3. locate the damping connection.
steps.observation: 阻尼器的相對運動與建築的絕對位移不是同一個量。
steps.observationEn: Damper relative motion and building absolute displacement are different quantities.
steps.failure: 擺錘移動很大就表示建築一定失去承載能力。
steps.failureEn: Large pendulum motion necessarily means the building has lost load capacity.
steps.check: 提交兩自由度示意及三種位移定義。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-degree schematic and three displacement definitions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 調諧質量阻尼器是耦合動力系統；它利用相對運動調整主系統反應。
knowledge.textEn: A tuned mass damper is a coupled dynamic system that uses relative motion to modify primary-system response.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 觀景照片只能顯示裝置外形，不能直接給出控制性能或當時荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Observation-deck photos show device appearance, not control performance or concurrent loading.

quiz.question: 審查「畫出調諧質量阻尼器雙系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Draw a tuned-mass-damper model”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 阻尼器的相對運動與建築的絕對位移不是同一個量。
擺錘移動很大就表示建築一定失去承載能力。
擺錘的相對位移就是地面量到的建築位移。
optionsEn: Damper relative motion and building absolute displacement are different quantities.
Large pendulum motion necessarily means the building has lost load capacity.
Pendulum relative displacement equals building displacement measured from the ground.
quiz.explanation: 調諧質量阻尼器是耦合動力系統；它利用相對運動調整主系統反應。 觀景照片只能顯示裝置外形，不能直接給出控制性能或當時荷載。
quiz.explanationEn: A tuned mass damper is a coupled dynamic system that uses relative motion to modify primary-system response. Observation-deck photos show device appearance, not control performance or concurrent loading.

steps.title: 理解調諧與離調的差異
steps.objective: 用比較而非實樓設定值理解頻率匹配。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand frequency matching through comparison rather than real-building settings.
steps.instruction: 1. 建立無量綱兩振子示例；2. 比較接近及偏離主頻率的輔助振子；3. 保持激振條件一致再比較反應曲線。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create a dimensionless two-oscillator example; 2. compare near-tuned and detuned auxiliary oscillators; 3. hold excitation fixed before comparing responses.
steps.observation: 調諧效果取決於頻率關係與阻尼，不能只看質量大小。
steps.observationEn: Tuning performance depends on frequency relationships and damping, not mass alone.
steps.failure: 阻尼球越重就能在所有頻率下消除全部晃動。
steps.failureEn: A heavier damper ball eliminates all motion at every frequency.
steps.check: 繳交一致激振下的兩條比較曲線與假設。
steps.checkEn: Provide two response comparisons under identical excitation with assumptions.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 調諧具有頻率範圍；真實建築存在多模態，單一裝置不是所有反應的萬能解。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning is frequency-dependent; real buildings have multiple modes, so one device is not a universal remedy.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設模型只能展示參數敏感度，不能回推原裝置的調整方法。
knowledge.textEn: An invented model illustrates parameter sensitivity and cannot reconstruct adjustment procedures for the actual device.

quiz.question: 審查「理解調諧與離調的差異」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Understand tuning and detuning”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 阻尼球越重就能在所有頻率下消除全部晃動。
調諧效果取決於頻率關係與阻尼，不能只看質量大小。
調諧裝置只影響單一時刻，與激振頻率無關。
optionsEn: A heavier damper ball eliminates all motion at every frequency.
Tuning performance depends on frequency relationships and damping, not mass alone.
A tuned device affects only one instant and is independent of excitation frequency.
quiz.explanation: 調諧具有頻率範圍；真實建築存在多模態，單一裝置不是所有反應的萬能解。 自設模型只能展示參數敏感度，不能回推原裝置的調整方法。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning is frequency-dependent; real buildings have multiple modes, so one device is not a universal remedy. An invented model illustrates parameter sensitivity and cannot reconstruct adjustment procedures for the actual device.

steps.title: 拆解黏滯耗能與行程邊界
steps.titleEn: Separate viscous dissipation from stroke limits
steps.objective: 理解阻尼與碰撞限制各自的功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate functions of damping and travel limits.
steps.instruction: 1. 在雙振子圖標出相對速度；2. 用概念迴圈畫能量消散；3. 另以虛線標出有限行程而不設定實際數值。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Mark relative velocity in the two-oscillator diagram; 2. sketch a conceptual dissipation loop; 3. mark finite travel separately without actual settings.
steps.observation: 限制行程與消耗振動能量是不同但需協調的功能。
steps.observationEn: Limiting travel and dissipating vibration energy are distinct coordinated functions.
steps.failure: 只要有止擋就不需要分析相對運動及耗能。
steps.failureEn: A stop makes relative-motion and energy-dissipation analysis unnecessary.
steps.check: 提供耗能路徑及行程邊界的分色圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a color-separated diagram of dissipation and travel boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 黏滯裝置可把機械能轉為熱；碰撞或止擋會改變系統的非線性反應。
knowledge.textEn: Viscous devices convert mechanical energy to heat; contact or stops change nonlinear system response.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 看見止擋或阻尼器的存在並不等於已驗證其安裝及可用狀態。
knowledge.textEn: The visible presence of stops or dampers does not verify their installation or availability.

quiz.question: 審查「拆解黏滯耗能與行程邊界」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Separate viscous dissipation from stroke limits”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 只要有止擋就不需要分析相對運動及耗能。
止擋接觸只限制位置，絕不改變系統動態反應。
限制行程與消耗振動能量是不同但需協調的功能。
optionsEn: A stop makes relative-motion and energy-dissipation analysis unnecessary.
Stop contact only limits position and never changes system dynamics.
Limiting travel and dissipating vibration energy are distinct coordinated functions.
quiz.explanation: 黏滯裝置可把機械能轉為熱；碰撞或止擋會改變系統的非線性反應。 看見止擋或阻尼器的存在並不等於已驗證其安裝及可用狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: Viscous devices convert mechanical energy to heat; contact or stops change nonlinear system response. The visible presence of stops or dampers does not verify their installation or availability.

steps.title: 比較位移、速度與加速度
steps.objective: 選擇能回答問題的量測量。
steps.objectiveEn: Select observations that answer the intended question.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫一條平滑概念位移曲線；2. 標出速度與加速度較大的區段；3. 將舒適與間隙問題配到不同觀察量。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw a smooth conceptual displacement curve; 2. identify high-speed and high-acceleration portions; 3. map comfort and clearance questions to different observations.
steps.observation: 相同峰值位移的兩段振動可能具有不同峰值加速度。
steps.observationEn: Two motions with equal peak displacement can have different peak accelerations.
steps.failure: 最大位移相同便能保證使用者感受完全相同。
steps.failureEn: Equal maximum displacement guarantees identical occupant experience.
steps.check: 繳交問題、觀察量與量測限制的三欄表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a table of questions, observations and measurement limits.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 對相同振幅的正弦運動，頻率改變會顯著影響加速度；不能只看位移。
knowledge.textEn: For equal-amplitude sinusoidal motion, frequency changes strongly affect acceleration; displacement alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 數值微分會放大量測雜訊，觀察量轉換需要處理誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Numerical differentiation amplifies measurement noise, so converting observations requires error treatment.

quiz.question: 審查「比較位移、速度與加速度」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare displacement, velocity and acceleration”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 相同峰值位移的兩段振動可能具有不同峰值加速度。
最大位移相同便能保證使用者感受完全相同。
將位移曲線微分不會增加量測雜訊影響。
optionsEn: Two motions with equal peak displacement can have different peak accelerations.
Equal maximum displacement guarantees identical occupant experience.
Differentiating displacement never increases the effect of measurement noise.
quiz.explanation: 對相同振幅的正弦運動，頻率改變會顯著影響加速度；不能只看位移。 數值微分會放大量測雜訊，觀察量轉換需要處理誤差。
